svg.title: GC-MoE CUDA Green Context SM Partitioning, 3-Node CUDA Graph, and Symmetric Memory Pipeline
svg.desc: Top panel contrasts DeepGEMM Mega MoE sharing all 148 B300 SMs per CTA with a trailing tag-2 cross-rank barrier against GC-MoE splitting 20 communication SMs and 128 compute SMs with parity-buffered barrier removal. Bottom panel diagrams the 3-node child CUDA Graph (concurrent roots role1 dispatch and role2 grouped GEMM feeding role3 finalize) interacting with the single device-persistent symmetric-memory workspace over NVLink.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
